items.summary: CFO recommendation: preserve containment and admit no new finance, implementation, telemetry, or duplicate reporting work this cycle. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, with 57 improvements measuring, 21 failed requests, and 108 approved proposals lacking execution. Complete or close the existing capacity-blocking repair case by 2026-10-01T09:00Z before admitting canonical work.

Financial disposition: revenue claims remain unsupported at site level. Amazon evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission, all aggregate under tracking_id=other. Do not claim site revenue, contribution margin, ROI, payback, forecast, or causal lift.

September AI spend was 5,531 calls costing $1,002.46, including 234 errors, or approximately $0.181 per call. Current AI telemetry covers only 4 sites, so fleet allocation is incomplete. The $4.92 Amazon amount and September AI cost are non-comparable periods and must not be presented as return or margin.

Contribution margin, infrastructure spend, budget exposure, and cost-to-learn are not calculable. Monthly spend, fixed-cost, marketing-budget, and revenue-floor fields are blank; infrastructure and operations sweeps have no results; experiment-level AI, implementation, labor, and infrastructure costs are not linked to hypotheses or outcomes. Minimum future measurement is an experiment-level ledger joining site, hypothesis, variant, request, dated direct costs, allocated shared costs, attributable revenue, and measured outcome.

Retain the existing attribution boundary: keep the $4.92 aggregate commission visible but unassigned, require registered tracking IDs for new links, and reject vanity metrics such as clicks, impressions, ordered items, or shipped items as profitability evidence without attributable commission and complete cost allocation. No additional finance proposal is justified because the required read-only telemetry already exists; the blocker is linkage and allocation.
